{{Short description|Indian actor|bot=PearBOT 5}} {{Use Indian English|date=February 2016}} {{Use dmy dates|date=July 2026}} {{Infobox person | name = Anand | image = | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|1968|02|21|df=yes}} | birth_place = [[Hyderabad]], [[Andhra Pradesh]] (now in [[Telangana]]), India | parents = | spouse = {{marriage|Poornima|2002}} | children = 1 | years_active = 1988–present | occupation = Actor | alma_mater = }} '''Anand Bharathi''' is an Indian actor who works predominantly in [[Telugu cinema|Telugu]], [[Tamil cinema|Tamil]], and [[Malayalam cinema|Malayalam]] films, and television shows. The actor's biggest film till date is [[Mani Ratnam]]'s black comedy ''[[Thiruda Thiruda]]'' (1993), but unlike his co-stars of that film, it failed to translate into a breakthrough for him. He has also played second lead roles and supporting characters in several films including [[Kamal Haasan]]'s ''[[Sathyaa]]'' and [[Vijayakanth]]'s ''[[Poonthotta Kaavalkaaran]]''.{{cite web|url=http://groups.google.com/group/rec.arts.movies.local.indian/browse_thread/thread/325160ecb408a6ad/bf2a05fc0546286b?pli=1 |title=Google Groups |access-date=2020-04-07}} ==Early and personal life== Anand was born in [[Hyderabad]] as the youngest of four sons. His father V. S. Bharathi, worked for [[Brooke Bond|Brooke Bond India Ltd]], and his mother Rajalakshmi is a house wife. His brothers are B. Ramesh, a Vice President of Finance with ''[[Times of India]]'', Dr. B. Suresh, a teacher at English Vivekananda College, and [[Bharat Arun]], a former Indian cricketer and now bowling coach for Indian cricket team. Anand also owns a restaurant named Zenzerro in [[Thiruvananthapuram]]. Anand has been married to actress Poornima since 2002. ==Career== He made his film debut in 1987 with ''[[Vanna Kanavugal]]''.{{cite web |title=Rediff On The NeT, Movies: Our weekly box office update |archive-date=2013-11-19 |title=Burglars strike at actor Anand's house|date=2008-08-01 |work=[[The Times of India]] |access-date=2012-05-18}} == Legal issues == In 2000, the actor was involved in a drunk driving hit-and-run case, where he hit a police officer who had tried to stop him. The police officer, Ramachandran, subsequently died due to his injuries and the actor faced a murder charge. The actor made a financial settlement with the victim's family. Later he was acquitted.{{Citation needed|date=May 2024}} His house in Uthandi, Chennai was burgled in 2008 and the actor cited that it was an "inside job". == Filmography == {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 100%;" !
